configuration.data:
kind: AdaptiveDialog
beginDialog:
  kind: OnEventActivity
  id: main
  eventName: Microsoft.PowerApps.Copilot.SetModelAppUniqueNameContext
  actions:
    - kind: ParseValue
      id: slMr2F
      variable: Global.PA_Copilot_Model_SessionContext_Version
      valueType: String
      value: =If(!IsBlank(System.Activity.ChannelData.SetModelAppUniqueNameContext_Version), Text(System.Activity.ChannelData.SetModelAppUniqueNameContext_Version), "-1")

    - kind: ParseValue
      id: r6ZsTS
      variable: Global.PA_Copilot_Model_SessionContext
      valueType:
        kind: Record
        properties:
          appId: String
          appUniqueName: String
          generativeAnswersSettings:
            type:
              kind: Record
              properties:
                bing_configuration_id: String
                public_websites:
                  type:
                    kind: Table
                    properties:
                      Value: String

                search_context: String
                search_type: String

          hostMode: String
          url: String
          userLocaleId: Number
          userId: String

      value: =If(!IsBlank(System.Activity.ChannelData.SetModelAppUniqueNameContext), System.Activity.ChannelData.SetModelAppUniqueNameContext, System.Activity.Value)

    - kind: SetVariable
      id: setVariable_7jxtSE
      variable: System.User.Language
      value: |-
        =Switch(Global.PA_Copilot_Model_SessionContext.userLocaleId,
          1033, Locale.English,
          1030, Locale.Danish,
          1043, Locale.Dutch,
          1036, Locale.French,
          1031, Locale.German,
          1040, Locale.Italian,
          1041, Locale.Japanese,
          1046, Locale.Portuguese_Brazilian,
          1034, Locale.Spanish,
          2052, Locale.Chinese_Simplified,
          1029, Locale.Czech,
          1035, Locale.Finnish,
          1032, Locale.Greek,
          1042, Locale.Korean,
          1044, Locale.Norwegian,
          1045, Locale.Polish,
          1049, Locale.Russian,
          1053, Locale.Swedish,
          1054, Locale.Thai,
          1055, Locale.Turkish,
          3082, Locale.Spanish,
          1025, Locale.Arabic,
          1037, Locale.Hebrew,
          Locale.English
        )
configuration.description: Triggered on Event received (Microsoft.PowerApps.Copilot.SetModelAppUniqueNameContext) to process the SessionContext
configuration.name: Model App Session Context - Event Trigger
